_comment: Role -> permission grants. Edit this file (not Python) to change who can do what; PROMPTS-style data-driven config, overridable with RBAC_POLICY_FILE. '*' grants everything. A trailing '.*' grants a whole namespace, e.g. 'ehr.*' covers ehr.read/write/delete. Unknown roles get no permissions (deny by default).

_permission_notes.ehr.read: List/fetch patient records (still scoped to records the caller owns)
_permission_notes.ehr.write: Create or update a patient record, record a dose
_permission_notes.alerts.read: View computed due-medication alerts and alert history
_permission_notes.alerts.send: Actually dispatch an alert to a clinician (email/SMS)
_permission_notes.report.write: Generate a structured report from a transcript or audio
_permission_notes.chat.write: Use chat paths that can mutate data via tools
_permission_notes.models.read: Read the model registry / health introspection
_permission_notes.audit.read: Read the audit trail (admin-only by default)
_permission_notes.pacs.read: Search/view imaging studies, DICOMweb reads, open the viewer
_permission_notes.pacs.write: Upload/import studies, edit worklist entries, link reports, retrieve from remote nodes
_permission_notes.pacs.admin: Manage DICOM nodes/peers, delete studies, forward/route studies
_permission_notes.clinical.read: Read the relational EHR chart, MPI search, federated records from peer hospitals
_permission_notes.clinical.write: Write EHR resources, register/merge MPI persons
_permission_notes.clinical.breakglass: Emergency access to a record without consent (always audited, reason required)
_permission_notes.interop.admin: Manage facilities/peers, view the interop message log, FHIR/HL7 endpoints admin
